SOURCE ORDEM_016_QG/A7/position_metric_bubble_engine.py; SHA256=48624a06ebfb510a359c4a46f75ca4a40f7e6e37fe8c9545bea4fccdc50cfa45; lines1-153
1: """Sparse, exact position-space contraction of the differentiated metric bubble.
2: 
3: Vertices act on (undifferentiated field, four differentiated fields) x ten
4: symmetric tensor components. All I/O stays in runners. K^1 expressions are
5: radial-frame profiles; no integrated covariant Hessian is inferred here.
6: """
7: from functools import lru_cache
8: from itertools import permutations
9: from math import factorial
10: from fractions import Fraction as F
11: from metric_principal_vertices import (I,basis,gamma2,contraction,upper_product,
12:                                        trace,eh_cubic_16k,clear_caches)
13: from metric_coincident_jet_engine_v2 import metric_fiber
14: 
15: SIZE=50
16: ZERO4=(0,0,0,0)
17: AXES=[tuple(int(i==j) for i in range(4)) for j in range(4)]
18: LABELS=[(i,j) for i in range(4) for j in range(i,4)]
19: BASIS=[basis(i,j) for i,j in LABELS]
20: def empty(n=SIZE):return [{} for _ in range(n)]
21: def transpose(A):
22:     out=empty(len(A))
23:     for i,row in enumerate(A):
24:         for j,x in row.items():out[j][i]=x
25:     return out
26: def mul(A,B):
27:     out=empty(len(A))
28:     for i,row in enumerate(A):
29:         dst=out[i]
30:         for k,a in row.items():
31:             for j,b in B[k].items():dst[j]=dst.get(j,0)+a*b
32:         out[i]={j:v for j,v in dst.items() if v}
33:     return out
34: def lincomb(*terms):
35:     out=empty(len(terms[0][1]))
36:     for c,A in terms:
37:         if not c:continue
38:         for i,row in enumerate(A):
39:             for j,v in row.items():out[i][j]=out[i].get(j,0)+c*v
40:     return [{j:v for j,v in row.items() if v} for row in out]
41: def frob(A,B):return sum(v*A[i].get(j,0) for i,row in enumerate(B) for j,v in row.items())
42: def sandwich(G,A,Q=None):return mul(mul(transpose(G),A),G if Q is None else Q)
43: def sparse(M):return [{j:int(M[i,j]) for j in range(M.cols) if M[i,j]} for i in range(M.rows)]
44: def block(out,i,j,M,c=1):
45:     for a,row in enumerate(M):
46:         for b,v in row.items():
47:             if v:out[10*i+a][10*j+b]=out[10*i+a].get(10*j+b,0)+c*v
48: 
49: @lru_cache(None)
50: def fiber_data():
51:     f=metric_fiber()
52:     S2=sparse(2*f['S0']);gg=sparse(f['g']*f['g'].T)
53:     oms={key:sparse(M) for key,M in f['omega'].items()}
54:     return S2,gg,oms
55: 
56: def green_integer(x):
57:     """Numerators G0/(2z³), G1/(24z²), G1_L/(24z²)."""
58:     x=tuple(x);z=sum(v*v for v in x);S2,gg,oms=fiber_data()
59:     A2=[lincomb(*[(x[j],oms[j,i]) for j in range(4)]) for i in range(4)]
60:     AS=[mul(A,S2) for A in A2]
61:     G0,G1,GL=empty(),empty(),empty()
62:     block(G0,0,0,S2,z*z);block(G1,0,0,S2,3*z*z);block(GL,0,0,gg,12*z*z)
63:     for i in range(4):
64:         block(G0,i+1,0,S2,-2*x[i]*z);block(G0,0,i+1,S2,2*x[i]*z)
65:         block(G1,i+1,0,lincomb((6*z,AS[i]),(24*z*x[i],gg)))
66:         block(G1,0,i+1,lincomb((6*z,AS[i]),(-24*z*x[i],gg)))
67:         for j in range(4):
68:             delta=int(i==j);n=z*delta-x[i]*x[j]
69:             block(G0,i+1,j+1,S2,2*delta*z-8*x[i]*x[j])
70:             part=lincomb((4*n,S2),(6*z,mul(oms[i,j],S2)),
71:                 (-12*x[i],AS[j]),(12*x[j],AS[i]),(24*(-delta*z+2*x[i]*x[j]),gg))
72:             block(G1,i+1,j+1,part)
73:     return G0,G1,GL,2*z**3,24*z*z
74: 
75: def cubic_from_gammas(fields,gs):
76:     result=0
77:     for i,j,k in permutations(range(3)):
78:         A=fields[i];G,T=gs[j],gs[k]
79:         result+=trace(A)*contraction(I,G,T)-2*contraction(A,G,T)
80:         result-=2*contraction(I,upper_product(A,G),T)
81:         result-=2*contraction(I,G,upper_product(A,T))
82:     return result
83: def gamma_gradient(grad):
84:     return tuple(grad[mu][4*nu+rho]+grad[nu][4*mu+rho]-grad[rho][4*mu+nu]
85:                  for rho in range(4) for mu in range(4) for nu in range(4))
86: 
87: @lru_cache(None)
88: def vertex_data(A):
89:     """W2, four W1 momentum coefficients, four twice-W1 connection coefficients."""
90:     W2=empty();W1=[empty() for _ in range(4)];WC2=[empty() for _ in range(4)]
91:     # Two internally differentiated legs, external derivative absent.
92:     for i in range(4):
93:         for a,Ea in enumerate(BASIS):
94:             ia=10*(i+1)+a
95:             for j in range(4):
96:                 for b,Eb in enumerate(BASIS):
97:                     jb=10*(j+1)+b
98:                     if jb<ia:continue
99:                     v=eh_cubic_16k(A,ZERO4,Ea,AXES[i],Eb,AXES[j])
100:                     if v:W2[ia][jb]=v;W2[jb][ia]=v
101:     f=metric_fiber();avec=[A[4*i+j] for i,j in LABELS]
102:     cg=[]
103:     for j in range(4):
104:         grad=[]
105:         for i in range(4):
106:             D=f['omega'][j,i]
107:             values=[sum(int(D[a,b])*avec[b] for b in range(10)) for a in range(10)]
108:             lookup={pair:v for pair,v in zip(LABELS,values)}
109:             grad.append(tuple(lookup[min(a,b),max(a,b)] for a in range(4) for b in range(4)))
110:         cg.append(gamma_gradient(grad))
111:     zg=(0,)*64
112:     for j in range(4):
113:         for i in range(4):
114:             for a,Ea in enumerate(BASIS):
115:                 ia=10*(i+1)+a
116:                 for b,Eb in enumerate(BASIS):
117:                     v=eh_cubic_16k(A,AXES[j],Ea,AXES[i],Eb,ZERO4)
118:                     c=cubic_from_gammas([A,Ea,Eb],[cg[j],gamma2(Ea,AXES[i]),zg])
119:                     if v:W1[j][ia][b]=v;W1[j][b][ia]=v
120:                     if c:WC2[j][ia][b]=c;WC2[j][b][ia]=c
121:     clear_caches()
122:     return W2,W1,WC2
123: 
124: def contracted_node(A,B,p,x,curved=True):
125:     """Return flat, K-constant and K-log profiles before angular averaging /16."""
126:     x=tuple(x);p=tuple(p);z=sum(v*v for v in x);px=sum(a*b for a,b in zip(p,x))
127:     G0,G1,GL,d0,d1=green_integer(x)
128:     a2,a1,ac=vertex_data(tuple(A));b2,b1,_=vertex_data(tuple(B))
129:     VX={1:lincomb(*[(-p[i],a1[i]) for i in range(4)]),2:a2}
130:     VY={1:lincomb(*[(p[i],b1[i]) for i in range(4)]),2:b2}
131:     flat=F();curve=F();log=F()
132:     for nx in (1,2):
133:         C0=sandwich(G0,VX[nx])
134:         C1=lincomb((1,sandwich(G0,VX[nx],G1)),(1,sandwich(G1,VX[nx],G0))) if curved else None
135:         CL=lincomb((1,sandwich(G0,VX[nx],GL)),(1,sandwich(GL,VX[nx],G0))) if curved else None
136:         for ny in (1,2):
137:             n=nx+ny;c0=frob(C0,VY[ny])
138:             flat+=F((-1)**n*px**n*c0,factorial(n)*d0*d0)
139:             if curved:
140:                 factor=F((-1)**(n-1)*px**(n-2),factorial(n-2))
141:                 curve+=factor*(F(frob(C1,VY[ny]),d0*d1)-F(z*c0,2*d0*d0))
142:                 log+=factor*F(frob(CL,VY[ny]),d0*d1)
143:     if curved:
144:         # Six times the external coframe momentum correction: -(z*p-x(px)).
145:         wp6=lincomb(*[(-(z*p[i]-x[i]*px),a1[i]) for i in range(4)])
146:         # Twice the external connection correction, excluding its -i.
147:         wc2=lincomb(*[(x[i],ac[i]) for i in range(4)])
148:         CP=sandwich(G0,wp6);CC=sandwich(G0,wc2)
149:         for ny in (1,2):
150:             n=1+ny
151:             curve+=F((-1)**(n-1)*px**(n-2)*frob(CP,VY[ny]),factorial(n-2)*6*d0*d0)
152:             curve+=F((-1)**n*px**(n-1)*frob(CC,VY[ny]),factorial(n-1)*2*d0*d0)
153:     return tuple(value*z*z/16 for value in (flat,curve,log))
